activity.notes: Emperor Gaozong was restored to the throne in 1129 after the brief forced abdication and remained emperor until his abdication in 1162. This is a distinct restored-reign Activity; sub-year boundaries are intentionally not asserted here.

sources.title: Song: Emperors: 1127-1276 — Archontology
sources.citation_text: The chronology separately records Gaozong's restoration in 1129 and his restored reign through 1162.

sources.title: Quatrain on Heavenly Mountain — The Metropolitan Museum of Art
sources.citation_text: The Metropolitan Museum of Art identifies Emperor Gaozong as ruling 1127–1162 and notes his retirement from the throne in 1162.
